decision: AIDY production runtime and health recovery must not depend on GitHub Actions availability. During the temporary Actions credit outage, use trusted external exact-SHA acceptance and preserve the intent of branch protections rather than repeatedly rerunning unavailable CI.

decision: AIDY decisions must be persisted immutably with the exact PIT-safe evidence available at decision time and later scored against a fixed counterfactual baseline. The primary success metric is factual decision delta: money made/saved or money lost because AIDY intervened.
reason: The owner requires AIDY to become measurably better at approving, denying, holding, conflicting and closing trades, not merely produce narrative confidence or hindsight analysis.

decision: AIDY must maintain conditional provider intelligence and a persistent hypothesis/question registry covering direction, session, regime, volatility/liquidity proxies, management quality, TP progression, duplicates, latency, agreement/conflict, adverse duration and recovery behaviour; insufficient evidence must resolve to unknown.
reason: Provider quality is conditional and multidimensional; one overall win rate cannot support safe decision authority.

decision: Once Provider Context is healthy, generate shadow decisions for every eligible Super Signals trade and graduate decision authority by class rather than all at once: deterministic duplicate rejection first, then obvious exposure conflicts, then provider/regime denies, then early-close management and broader authority. Every class requires a kill switch, audit trail, prospective evidence and explicit owner/live gate.
reason: The owner wants AIDY making smart decisions very soon, while preserving factual learning, reversibility and the existing live-risk boundary.

decision: Owner gave a standing mandate: profit is the explicit goal (growing the balance or preventing losses, same goal), AIDY must become a full evidence-scored decision layer that knows each signal group's behaviour, can approve/deny/close-early/hold signals with explained reasoning, and must be continuously measurable on whether its decisions actually helped. Owner authorizes Claude to make routine engineering and product decisions without asking first, to propose costed spend up to roughly EUR200/month beyond existing ~EUR500/month costs, and to build new infrastructure (dashboards, databases, services) as needed. Full text pinned at OWNER_MANDATE.md so it does not need repeating. The one boundary this does not touch: AIDY's live-money/broker execution authority stays OFF and the 1% live-risk directive does not change silently -- both already stood as AGENTS.md rules before this mandate and remain in force, restated explicitly so 'full access to everything' is never later misread as having quietly overridden them.

AIDY's strategic destination is a full point-in-time Gold specialist, not merely a provider scorer. Build claim-grounded reasoning, a qualified Gold-state dossier, breaking-news/event intelligence, liquidity/execution intelligence, conditional provider alpha decomposition, regime-matched historical analogue memory, calibrated probability/expected-value decisions, profit-extraction management research, failure attribution/UNKNOWN handling, and continuous self-critique/ablation. Every provider-specific rationale claim must be addressable to exact PIT evidence; unsupported claims are forbidden. News is context rather than an automatic directional command. AIDY must explain abnormal Gold moves and trade failures when evidence supports a mechanism, and explicitly say UNKNOWN when it does not. The two-repo boundary remains hard: Aidy-Gold-Signals owns market/research intelligence, Super Signals owns provider/broker execution, and exchange happens only through versioned PIT-safe contracts. Live-money authority remains OFF until each decision class independently passes prospective counterfactual/calibration/adversarial gates and receives explicit owner approval.
reason: Owner explicitly wants AIDY to know why Gold moves, why trades fail, when liquidity matters, how to maximise winner extraction, how historical regimes match, and when each provider is conditionally strong; the live reasoning audit also proved unsupported provider-history claims must be technically impossible rather than merely discouraged.
source: owner directive and architecture agreement 2026-09-19; MASTER_GOLD_INTELLIGENCE_BUILD.md

decision: Phase 0/1 anti-drift is now a hard evidence contract in the Super Signals AIDY reasoning path. Provider performance evidence is scoped to the current signal side/session; missing cohorts remain UNKNOWN; raw provider identity/profile/fingerprint prose is not exposed to the model; provider-history influence is represented only by validated provider_claim_refs tied to immutable PIT evidence carrying source path, value, sample N, version and timestamp. Unsupported refs or prohibited free-form provider-history claims fail safe rather than persisting a successful annotation. Production grounding health is queryable and legacy rows remain explicitly legacy_unvalidated rather than being rewritten.
reason: The live Scalping audit proved that plausible provider-history prose could drift beyond the exact PIT profile. The owner explicitly required anti-drift to be built and proven before the wider Gold-intelligence programme continues.
